method.model: SQLite transaction model matching documented Cloudflare D1 batch rollback semantics

scenarios.assertion: Signed OAuth state is expiring, PKCE-bound, and tamper evident
A forced later statement failure rolls activation and both nonce consumptions back
Duplicate immutable X ID and duplicate wallet are rejected without consuming a gift slot
Callback replay consumes neither a second identity activation nor a second gift slot
Serialized 999-to-1000 contention produces exactly one slot 1000 and one active capacity result
Activation-first ordering prevents a zero-row activation from committing an orphan reservation
Token and profile requests retain independent five-second deadlines and fail-closed outcomes
Unknown Premium tier, malformed creation time, and accounts younger than 40 complete days fail closed

externalSemanticsReference.relevantBoundary: Statements run sequentially; a failing statement aborts and rolls back the batch, while a successful zero-row statement is not itself a failure

limitations: This is a credential-free local SQLite model, not an actual Cloudflare D1 integration run
No X OAuth token exchange or profile request was made
Provider-returned Premium and account-age fields remain an external trust boundary
This is internal Codex-assisted evidence, not independent review
This is not signed Devnet evidence and does not authorize funding, scheduling, signing, broadcast, deployment, or Mainnet
